Claim: PM loop round 28 (serial) · `domain:cli` seat 2 · p2 · ruling 乙 (the maintainer's 「乙 统一成一套」), filed by this seat; it folds #25113 · 2026-10-21T19:42Z
Session: `session_01LmjU2x1faLZ39DVTFyVca6`
Account: `os-justin` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; always the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-25119-cloud-connection-one-rule`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-25119`
Domain: `domain:cli`
Seat: `domain:cli#2` (seat post #22648)
File surface (read on `origin/main` `1b3b65e643`; line numbers move; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- `packages/cloud-connection/src/cloud-connection-plugin.ts`:
  - **one capability gate,** `manage_platform_settings`, replaces `setup.access` (`holdsSetupAccess` about `:516`, `refuseWithoutSetupAccess` about `:551`) at `POST bind/start`, `POST bind/poll` and `POST unbind`, and at `GET status`'s full-record branch (about `:579`). A caller without it keeps the narrow status shape. There is one resolver and no second reading of the grant; the precedent is `service-datasource`'s admin routes (#9593).
  - **managed runtime:** `bind/start` and `bind/poll` refuse as `unbind` does, with 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` after the identity and capability checks and before any control-plane call or store write.
  - the header's #24148 sentence becomes true again for the entry, the page and the doors.
- `packages/cloud-connection/src/cloud-connection-ui.ts`: the page `cloud_connection_settings` declares `requiredPermissions: ['manage_platform_settings']`, if pages carry that key (measure first; if they do not, say how the page is gated).
- Pins:
  - an `organization_admin`-only caller (`setup.access` without `manage_platform_settings`) is refused at every door and served the narrow status;
  - a `manage_platform_settings` holder is served as before;
  - the managed refusal covers all three doors.
  - The existing pins are updated, never loosened: `cloud-connection-auth-gate`, `cloud-connection-setup-access`, `cloud-connection-platform-managed`, `error-envelope.conformance`.
- Docs: `content/docs/deployment/cloud-connection.mdx`, and any page naming `setup.access` as this capability's gate.
- A changeset for `@objectstack/cloud-connection`.
- ⛔ Hold-offs: the device-code flow's own steps; the status shape for a permitted caller; `packages/spec/**`; `packages/platform-objects` (the Setup app's group gate stays as it is).
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier` (`dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` at `1b3b65e643`: "no path-derived mandate")
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Basis for the Clause-② line: a caller holding `setup.access` without `manage_platform_settings` (the default `organization_admin` set) loses the three doors, the page and the full status record, and a managed runtime refuses two more doors. Nothing widens. It owes one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review of record before the queue.
Responsibility: this lane's `packages/cloud-connection`. The platform rule it adopts is the Integrations group's own gate. It reaches every runtime's cloud-connection doors.
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared:
- No open PR touches `packages/cloud-connection/**` or `cloud-connection.mdx`. All 9 open PRs were read in this act.
- This seat's PR #25136 (`packages/runtime`) and PR #25130 (`packages/rest`) are disjoint.
Mode: serial. This is the seat's only dev in flight.
